description: Calculate the count of movies and average rating for each director, having at least 1 movie, ordered by movie count descending.

expected_queries.cypher:
MATCH (d:Person)-[r:DIRECTED]->(m:Movie)
RETURN d.name AS director_name, count(m.id) AS movie_count, avg(m.rating) AS avg_rating
ORDER BY movie_count DESC
LIMIT $p0
expected_queries.sql_pgq:
SELECT
  gt.director_name,
  COUNT(gt.movie_id) AS movie_count,
  AVG(gt.movie_rating) AS avg_rating
FROM GRAPH_TABLE (
  movie_graph
  MATCH (d:Person) -[r:DIRECTED]-> (m:Movie)
  COLUMNS (
    d.name AS director_name,
    m.id AS movie_id,
    m.rating AS movie_rating
  )
) AS gt
GROUP BY gt.director_name
ORDER BY movie_count DESC
LIMIT :p0
